name: manual_d50d16
claim: Treat a post-spawn OSError or usage-like output as an unknown effect unless reliable evidence proves no request was sent; do not clear the durable claim based only on error text.

decisions.notes: Provisional correction to the broad reading of lesson_3413c1a3ed12: synthetic fault injection at Orama 71ab3560 showed post-send text and post-spawn I/O can be misclassified; see MAC_POSIX_EVIDENCE_AND_LOCK_BOUNDARIES_2026-11-10.md.
